facts.fact: The Data Protection and Privacy Office newsletter reports its then head saying on 11 September 2025 that Rwanda's National Data Sharing Policy guides responsible data handling alongside the data protection law.

The Data Protection and Privacy Office newsletter reports its then head saying on 11 September 2025 that Rwanda's Personal Data Protection and Privacy Law guides responsible data handling and urging staff training and regular audits to comply.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Law

facts.fact: The newsletter, issued by the Data Protection and Privacy Office of the National Cyber Security Authority, says its head was appointed Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of ICT and Innovation on 18 September 2025.

RWA.note: Rwanda hosting the Africa Cyber Defense Forum is not stated to be a meeting of an African digital-policy body.
